# crnp 0.2.0

* Formalized the frozen coverage-adaptive CRNP estimator as an R package.
* Added conservative mapping audit and multiple-feature aggregation utilities.
* Added the seven projection methods frozen for external evaluation.
* Added source-implied fidelity and known-answer coverage evaluation.
* Added automated invariant, mapping, API, reproducibility, and evaluation tests.
* Added a phenotype-free six-matrix synthetic dry run matching the planned
  three-platform, two-biofluid external evaluation structure.
